acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of electrical fixture installation in Berkeley varies based on several factors, including the type of fixture, the complexity of the installation, and whether new wiring or a new electrical box is required. Simple replacements typically cost less, while installing a new fixture in a location without existing wiring will be more expensive. It's best to get a detailed quote from a local electrician at Frasheski Construction, as prices can also differ based on labor rates in the East Bay area.
